answer: Verdicts stay unpaid six epochs, and anyone may reopen one with a bond of twice the stake before a panel of keys sharing no funding source. Overturn: the bond returns triple from the first panel's staked fees; uphold: it pays them. A thousand clones hold a thousand rewards frozen while one stranger reopens the lot at once. Bonds come from a pool fed by a 5% levy, so dust identities aggregate into challengeable mass; rewards season like timber, six epochs of drying. Limits: it bites only where pooled stake beats the cost of arguing. A sable pelt earns a retrial; a meadow of claims does not.
